example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় তার গলা ওঠা শুরু হলো যখন সে অসম্মতি জানাল।
রাগের মあまり তার গলা ওঠে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His voice rose in the meeting when he expressed disagreement.
She raised her voice in anger during the argument.
note: This idiom is commonly used in spoken Bengali to indicate increasing volume in speech, often in emotional contexts.
